.aee/changed-files.json — Repo Checker manifest tracking added/modified/deleted files under src/ since the last run; beforeSha is null on first run, then carries forward as the comparison baseline for subsequent runs
.aee/security-log.jsonl — per-file security analysis summary (file, findingCount, criticalCount, highCount, analyzedAt); skipped files carry skipped:true and skipReason
.aee/intake.jsonl — File Intake Classifier log; one JSON line per file with fields: file, hash, language, component, batch, arrivedAt; skipped files carry skipped:true
.aee/intake-summary.md — human-readable summary produced by the File Intake Classifier after each run: counts per language and component, skip count, and UNKNOWN files flagged for human review
.aee/link-graph.json — Relationship Linker output; top-level keys: resolved, ambiguous, unresolved, crossComponentSeams; written each run when the seam or reference sets change
.aee/link-summary.md — human-readable Relationship Linker summary: reference counts, cross-component seams with join keys, unresolved references table, and open-end report when delivery is partial

docs/components/ — Synthesizer output directory: one Markdown file per component (Overview, File Inventory, Defined Symbols, External Dependencies, Side Effects, Component Diagram, Local Data Flow, Cross-Component Interfaces) plus index.md listing all components

.aee/security-chains.json — Cross-File Security Correlator output; array of confirmed and partial taint chains, each with chainId, source, hops (file+lineRange+symbol+crossComponent), sink, owaspCategory, cweId, severity, confidence, severityUpgraded, and sanitisationGaps fields

.aee/security-chains-summary.md — human-readable summary of security chains: confirmed/partial counts, severity breakdown, cross-component seam note, and per-chain source→sink table with OWASP/CWE columns

.aee/dependency-inventory.json — Dependency Analyzer output; JSON array of all declared dependencies with fields: manifest, lineRange, name, version, component, ecosystem, scope, advisories; empty array when no manifests found

.aee/dependency-advisories.json — Dependency Analyzer output; filtered subset of dependency-inventory.json containing only entries with at least one advisory match, sorted by severity (critical first)

.aee/dependency-summary.md — human-readable Dependency Analyzer summary: Manifest Inventory table, Advisory Matches table, Unpinned Dependencies table, Notes section; notes 'zero manifests found' when repository has no pom.xml/requirements.txt/package.json/go.mod

.aee/infrastructure-inventory.json — Infrastructure Analyzer output; top-level keys: dockerfiles, terraform, kubernetes; each is an empty array when no infrastructure files are found in the repository

.aee/infrastructure-findings.json — Infrastructure Analyzer output; JSON array of configuration findings (unpinned images, runs-as-root, privileged containers, etc.); empty array when no infrastructure files present

.aee/infrastructure-summary.md — human-readable Infrastructure Analyzer summary: Infrastructure Inventory section, Configuration Findings section, Secrets Detected counts (values redacted), Notes section

.aee/license-inventory.json — License Compliance Analyzer output; top-level keys: generatedAt, productLicense (null if no top-level LICENSE* found), components (array), copyleftConflicts (array), attributionGaps (array), notes; empty arrays and null productLicense when no license-bearing files are found

.aee/license-summary.md — human-readable License Compliance Analyzer summary: Product License section, Component Inventory table, Copyleft Conflicts section, Attribution Gaps section, Notes section; notes 'zero bundled components detected' when no vendor/third_party directories or LICENSE* files exist
.aee/revision-rounds.txt — Verifier Critic round counter; integer (0-indexed, starting absent/0); hard cap triggers escalation path when current count >= 3 before incrementing

.aee/verification-report.json — Verifier Critic output; JSON array of verdict objects (documentType, documentRef, issueType, location, description, sourceFile, lineRange, severity); empty array when all documents pass

.aee/verification-summary.md — Verifier Critic human-readable summary: counts by issue type/severity, errors table, and clean-document list; 'Escalated — max revision rounds (3) reached' heading used in hard-cap path

docs/architecture/ — Architecture Artifact Generator output directory: system.md (overview, component inventory, dependency map, data flow, external deps), security-posture.md (findings by severity, taint chains, cross-component seams, verification status), dependency-matrix.md (N×N cross-component reference count matrix, bold cells for taint-chain-crossing seams), unresolved.md (unresolved refs, partial chains, UNKNOWN files, verification errors)
